**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a mixed buffet-style plate. It holds a large rotisserie chicken portion (breast/half with wing), a breaded chicken drumette, a granola bar piece, a cucumber spear, a piece of fresh spring roll and two vegetable maki rolls.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** It is a white rimmed dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Rotisserie chicken (skin-on, bone-in)
- Breaded/fried chicken drumette
- Granola bar with chocolate chunks
- Cucumber spear
- Fresh rice-paper spring roll piece
- 2 cucumber/vegetable maki pieces

No visible sauce.

**STEP 4 - Area (food covers ~45%):**

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken | 22% | 117 cm² |
| Drumette | 4% | 21 cm² |
| Granola bar | 3% | 16 cm² |
| Cucumber | 5% | 27 cm² |
| Spring roll | 5% | 27 cm² |
| Maki | 6% | 32 cm² |

Total = 45%.

**STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):**

| Item | Area × height | Gross volume |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken | 117 × 4 cm | ≈ 470 ml |
| Drumette | 21 × 3 cm | ≈ 63 ml |
| Granola bar | 16 × 1.5 cm | ≈ 24 ml |
| Cucumber | 27 × 2 cm | ≈ 54 ml |
| Spring roll | 27 × 2.5 cm | ≈ 68 ml |
| Maki | 32 × 2.5 cm | ≈ 80 ml |

**STEP 6 - Grams (volume × bulk density):**

| Item | Volume × density | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken | 470 × 0.7 (bone and cavity) | ≈ 330 g |
| Drumette | 63 × 0.8 | ≈ 50 g |
| Granola bar | 24 × 0.8 | ≈ 20 g |
| Cucumber | 54 × 0.7 | ≈ 38 g |
| Spring roll | 68 × 0.7 | ≈ 48 g |
| Maki | 80 × 0.6 | ≈ 48 g |

**STEP 7 - Energy:**

| Item | Weight × kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken | 330 g × 180 (bone-in with skin) | 594 kcal |
| Drumette | 50 g × 260 | 130 kcal |
| Granola bar | 20 g × 450 | 90 kcal |
| Cucumber | 38 g × 15 | 6 kcal |
| Spring roll | 48 g × 120 | 58 kcal |
| Maki | 48 g × 145 | 70 kcal |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 534 g and 948 kcal. That is plausible, since a large rotisserie chicken portion dominates the plate and the rest are small sides.
